🤖 Talos triage · confidence: medium

Talos can make mistakes. Please check important information.

Verdict
No defect found in this customer's report configuration or in the scheduling code; the run they describe landed one day after their financial year rolled over, so the exact date range that run actually covered has to be confirmed before anything else.

What we checked

  • This customer's financial calendar closes its year on 27 Sep 2026 and opens the next one on 28 Sep 2026, so the run they are describing is the first one after that rollover, while the two periods that did return records were both mid-year.

  • Every field this report depends on — the partner card details on the payment and the partner-discount marker — is still present and correctly mapped in this customer's configuration; nothing has been renamed, dropped or left unmapped.

Next

  • Pull this work item's run records for the last three periods and read the start/end dates each run actually covered, plus whether it completed, failed, or was held back waiting for data.

  • If the latest run did cover the closed period (24 Aug – 27 Sep 2026), count the matching refunds directly in that window and compare with the two prior periods.

Issue: Work item returned 0 results. Non-zero in prior 2 periods.

Context: This run is the first one after the client's fiscal year rollover (FY closes 27 Sep, new FY opens 28 Sep 2026); the two prior good periods were both mid-year, so the exact date range this run covered hasn't been confirmed. The relevant fields (partner card details, discount marker) are present and correctly mapped in config.

Steps to review/replicate:

  1. Pull run records for the last 3 periods for this work item; read the actual start/end date range each run covered and its completion status (completed / failed / held).

  2. If the latest run did cover the closed period (24 Aug–27 Sep), manually count matching refunds in that window and compare to the prior two periods.

  3. Confirm whether any refund/payment-method field for c166_sbx was touched by the 8/27 cutover, similar to the StoreManager/MemberID remaps in RCS-28873.

Next steps: If the date range is wrong or truncated at the FY boundary, this points to a scheduling bug at fiscal-year rollover. Worth checking if other customers whose FY just rolled are similarly affected. If the run covered the right window and genuinely found zero refunds, and no cutover-related field issue turns up, this is likely a legitimate data outcome, confirm with customer.

Escalating to Delivery, Secure 5. The Refunds to a Partners SVC or Credit Debit Card with no Partner Discount definition returns 0 for fiscal period 24 Aug to 27 Sep. The field it filters on stopped arriving at the 27 Aug SnowTime cutover. Support cannot change the mapping.

1. Environment and steps to reproduce

Prod. Tenant starbucks-us, c166_sbx, ARDM_PRODUCTION.C166_SBX.

Starbucks NA (SBX), reported 30 Sep

  1. Snowflake, SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.QUERY_HISTORY, user SVC_ARP_PRODUCTION_166_USER, 30 Sep 02:08:49 PT. Trigger search with T1.TransactionType = 2 AND T3.x_partnerownedtoken = :tender_ext_partnerownedtoken.

  2. Run:

SELECT CASE WHEN h.TradingDay < '2026-08-27' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS window,
       t.x_partnerownedtoken, COUNT(*) AS refunds
FROM ARDM_PRODUCTION.C166_SBX.ARDM_HEADER h
JOIN ARDM_PRODUCTION.C166_SBX.ARDM_TENDER t
  ON t.TransactionID = h.TransactionID AND t.TradingDay = h.TradingDay
WHERE h.TradingDay BETWEEN '2026-07-27' AND '2026-09-27' AND h.TransactionType = 2
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;

Expected: x_partnerownedtoken TRUE on partner refunds in both windows. Actual: TRUE on 3,927 refunds before 27 Aug, on none after. 204,745 refunds after 27 Aug, all NULL.

2. Findings

Detail in my internal note of 1 Oct. Refund volume is normal. Only the token is missing, so the trigger search returns 0 rows with no error.

3. Troubleshooting performed

Snowflake query history and the query above. Partner flags on ardm_header checked in the same window, unchanged. Asked Sebastian Rueda on 1 Oct who owns the SnowTime tender mapping for c166_sbx. He did not know. No other conversations.

4. Still open

  1. Is x_partnerownedtoken mapped for c166_sbx in the SnowTime tender model, and who owns that mapping?

  2. Once mapped, can the field be reloaded for refunds from 27 Aug, and the 24 Aug to 27 Sep run regenerated?

Related: https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RCS-29207
